name: services/terms/terms_index
description: Get the list of all Academic Terms defined in this installation.
brief_description: Get the list of all terms.

arguments.name: term_type
arguments.description: One of following values: year, semester, trimester

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: The list of dictionaries, each dictionary describes one term (as defined in the term method. Returned items will be ordered by their order_key (ascending).
